A WOODLAND STUDY / 01

Stay a little.

A sunlit stand of maple and silver birch, at the brief moment when autumn is everywhere.

The stroll follows a clear trail at an easy pace, turns gently at its ends, and continues back through the woodland. Drag to look around; pause whenever you like.

Made from mathematics

Original procedural trees, bark, leaves and light. Open Scene to adjust the atmosphere or enable woodland ambience and three rotating instrumental pieces. Sound starts off.

Creative direction: zhone. Generated implementation: Codex. The complete brief and generation prompts are in the asset notes.
